Defect: operator-facing docs and NOTES.txt described a pre-#91 verification flow. They exposed only nfs.io/quota-status and treated a running pod as the last nearby success signal, omitting nfs.io/enforced-limit-bytes, which records the filesystem hard limit actually applied and may differ from requested capacity. The refreshed guidance requires both annotations, a server-side report, and a disposable over-limit write; it also points offline-bundle verification to hack/verify-release.py. It preserves current chart defaults through Helm template values rather than hard-coding stale values.
